name: MANAGE_WIFI_NETWORK_SELECTION

name: MASTER_CLEAR

name: MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS

name: MODIFY_PHONE_STATE

name: MOUNT_FORMAT_FILESYSTEMS

name: MOUNT_UNMOUNT_FILESYSTEMS

name: NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES

name: NFC

name: NFC_TRANSACTION_EVENT

name: OVERRIDE_MEDIA_SESSION_OWNER

name: OVERRIDE_WIFI_CONFIG
description: Allows an application to modify any wifi configuration, even if created by another application.

name: PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS

name: PERSISTENT_ACTIVITY

name: POST_NOTIFICATIONS

name: POST_PROMOTED_NOTIFICATIONS
description: Required for apps to post promoted notifications.

name: PROVIDE_OWN_AUTOFILL_SUGGESTIONS

name: PROVIDE_PRIVATE_COMPUTE_SERVICES

name: PROVIDE_REMOTE_CREDENTIALS

name: QUERY_ADVANCED_PROTECTION_MODE

name: READ_ASSIST_STRUCTURE_SCREEN_CONTENT

name: READ_CALENDAR
description: Allows an application to read the user's calendar data.

name: READ_CALL_LOG

name: READ_CONTACTS

name: READ_DROPBOX_DATA

name: READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE

name: READ_HOME_APP_SEARCH_DATA

name: READ_HOME_TIME_ZONE

name: READ_INPUT_STATE

name: READ_LOGS

name: READ_MEDIA_AUDIO

name: READ_MEDIA_IMAGES

name: READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
description: Allows an application to read video files from external storage.

name: READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED

name: READ_NEARBY_STREAMING_POLICY

name: READ_PHONE_NUMBERS

name: READ_PHONE_STATE

name: READ_PRECISE_PHONE_STATE
description: Allows read only access to precise phone state.

name: READ_SMS

description: Allows applications to read the sync settings.

name: READ_SYNC_STATS

name: READ_VOICEMAIL

name: REBOOT

name: RECEIVE_MMS
description: Allows an application to monitor incoming MMS messages.

name: RECEIVE_SENSITIVE_NOTIFICATIONS

name: RECEIVE_SMS
description: Allows an application to receive SMS messages.

name: RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH

name: REORDER_TASKS

name: REQUEST_COMPANION_PROFILE_COMPUTER

name: REQUEST_COMPANION_PROFILE_GLASSES
description: Allows app to request to be associated with a device via CompanionDeviceManager as "glasses"

name: REQUEST_COMPANION_PROFILE_MEDICAL
description: Allows application to request to associate with a AssociationRequest.DEVICE_PROFILE_MEDICAL device via CompanionDeviceManager.

name: REQUEST_COMPANION_PROFILE_NEARBY_DEVICE_STREAMING
description: Allows application to request to stream content from an Android host to a nearby device (AssociationRequest.DEVICE_PROFILE_NEARBY_DEVICE_STREAMING) by CompanionDeviceManager.

name: REQUEST_COMPANION_PROFILE_WATCH
description: Allows app to request to be associated with a device via CompanionDeviceManager as a "watch"

name: REQUEST_COMPANION_RUN_IN_BACKGROUND

name: REQUEST_COMPANION_SELF_MANAGED
description: Allows an application to create a "self-managed" association.

name: REQUEST_COMPANION_START_FOREGROUND_SERVICES_FROM_BACKGROUND

name: REQUEST_COMPANION_USE_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND

name: REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES

name: REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS

name: REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES

name: REQUEST_OBSERVE_COMPANION_DEVICE_PRESENCE

name: REQUEST_OBSERVE_DEVICE_UUID_PRESENCE

name: REQUEST_PASSWORD_COMPLEXITY

name: RESTART_PACKAGES

name: RUN_USER_INITIATED_JOBS
description: Allows applications to use the user-initiated jobs API.

name: SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM
description: Allows applications to use exact alarm APIs.

name: SEND_RESPOND_VIA_MESSAGE
description: Allows an application (Phone) to send a request to other applications to handle the respond-via-message action during incoming calls.

name: SEND_SMS
description: Allows an application to send SMS messages.

name: SET_ALARM
description: Allows an application to broadcast an Intent to set an alarm for the user.

name: SET_ALWAYS_FINISH
description: Allows an application to control whether activities are immediately finished when put in the background.

name: SET_ANIMATION_SCALE
description: Modify the global animation scaling factor.

name: SET_BIOMETRIC_DIALOG_ADVANCED

name: SET_DEBUG_APP

name: SET_PREFERRED_APPLICATIONS

name: SET_PROCESS_LIMIT

name: SET_TIME
description: Allows applications to set the system time directly.

name: SET_TIME_ZONE
description: Allows applications to set the system time zone directly.

name: SET_WALLPAPER
description: Allows applications to set the wallpaper.

name: SET_WALLPAPER_HINTS
description: Allows applications to set the wallpaper hints.

name: SHOW_POWER_MENU

name: SHOW_POWER_MENU_PRIVILEGED

name: SIGNAL_PERSISTENT_PROCESSES

name: SMS_FINANCIAL_TRANSACTIONS
description: This constant was deprecated in API level 31. The API that used this permission is no longer functional.

name: START_FOREGROUND_SERVICES_FROM_BACKGROUND
description: Allows an application to start foreground services from the background at any time.

name: START_VIEW_APP_FEATURES
description: Allows the holder to start the screen with a list of app features.

name: START_VIEW_PERMISSION_USAGE
description: Allows the holder to start the permission usage screen for an app.

name: STATUS_BAR
description: Allows an application to open, close, or disable the status bar and its icons.

name: SUBSCRIBE_TO_KEYGUARD_LOCKED_STATE
description: Allows an application to subscribe to device locked and keyguard locked (i.e., showing) state.

name: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW

name: TRANSMIT_IR

name: WRITE_CALL_LOG

name: WRITE_CONTACTS

name: WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE

name: WRITE_GSERVICES

name: WRITE_SETTINGS

name: WRITE_SYNC_SETTINGS
description: Allows applications to write the sync settings.

name: WRITE_SYSTEM_PREFERENCES
description: Allows an application to access the Settings Preference services to write settings values exposed by the system Settings app and system apps that contribute settings surfaced in the Settings app.
